pcs.pc_description: adhere to time limits given by supervisor
ensure that visual inspections of the body components for cracks are performed
check the oil levels in the engine, transmission, radiator coolant and brakes to ensure they are within the manufacturer's specifications
check the levels of differential and hydraulic oil
carry out inspections to ensure that the parking brake, main horn, reverse horn and headlights are in good working order
check fan belt tension, electrolyte level and terminal tightness
get a visual inspection to check the different controls, gauges, warning lights, and other safety devices
examine and adjust the driving position, rear and side mirrors, and seat belts to your comfort level
clean the dust bowls of the air filters and inspect the gasket and inner filter
inspect the greasing points to ensure that all greasing pins and pivots points are well greased
inspect the compressor, as well as every fittings and air lines
keep footplates and steps clean and free from mud, dirt and oil
before starting the compactor, go all the way around it to make sure no one is beneath or on it
verify that the machine has all of the manufacturer's safety, maintenance, and operating labels
keep inspection/maintenance logbook to keep track of all actions
if a fault is found that is outside of the scope of the position, notify the operator immediately

pcs.pc_description: plan and organize the job according to given instructions
examine the jobsite for loose soil, concealed deep ditches, or marshy spots where the backhoe might become trapped
perform all pre-operation and on-the-job inspections
ensure gear is in neutral position
wear seatbelt and adjust seat position
start the engine using the pushbutton switch and key switch
when starting the engine in cold weather, utilize the priming pump and pre-heater
operate tandem compactor in successive overlapping passes over surfaces to be compacted
determine the asphalt temperature at which compaction is optimal
ascertain that hot mix asphalt compaction is acceptable and in accordance with organization requirements
ensure that the subgrade and asphalt are properly compacted and smooth
determine the direction and speed of machine to ensure they are as per the compressibility of material under changing temperatures
ensuring that no ridges emerge as a result of high pressure
after completing operations, switch off ignition
inspect the gear position after usage to confirm that the gear is in neutral position
after using the equipment, leave it idle for few minutes
in the event of a crisis, use the emergency stop button to turn off all power to the compactor as instructed in the operator's handbook
